results.title: An Oil Giant Is Ripping Out Its Gas Pumps To Install BYD’s 1,500kW Flash Chargers
results.description: BYD and oil giant Sinopec are converting old gas stations into 1,500 kW Flash Charging hubs that refill an EV in nine minutes

results.title: Can hotel Wi-Fi really record your screen and audio? What Microsoft actually warned about
results.description: A viral claim says hotel Wi-Fi can record a traveller’s screen and audio, but Microsoft’s guidance does not make that claim. Its security advice focuses on fake hotspots, open networks and ransomware attacks against vulnerable systems.
